issues.reason: Reifying a scalar endpoint is gap territory (the reviewer's own first gap), a witness must always carry a class atom ('an untyped referent symbol must never appear in the output'), and (Member sk_level_1 level) is true of the referent and well-typed - graceful improvisation, not a defect.

Time is an event oblique - time atoms attach to an event witness or an event-denoting noun - so putting it on a value entity is the same category error the instruction set bars for Location on an entity; 'April's X' is a possessive and takes the licensed opaque (Possession <possessed> <possessor>).

The superlative form is (Most <scale> X <class>) 'plus X is a member of the class', and sk_level_2 is typed level, not unemployment_rate, so the class slot names a class the entity does not belong to.

Most has no span slot and 'since July 1994' restricts the comparison domain rather than any eventuality's interval (a Start on the rise would be false), so dropping it is the licensed handling of an unrepresentable adjunct - the reviewer's own second gap.

No adjective heads the change expression, so the dimension noun is what the instruction set says to record, and it explicitly tolerates dimension-noun and adjective scales not unifying ('weight-measures and heavy-comparatives need not unify yet'); the atom is true, and the missing chain is an inconvenience, not a falsehood.

gaps_confirmed: a scalar-change 'from X to Y' whose endpoints are measured values - Source/Goal are spatial, and there is no licensed way to reify a point on a scale as a referent
a superlative whose comparison domain is restricted by a time span ('its highest since July 1994') - Most takes only scale and class
the magnitude of a change ('inched up one-tenth of a percentage point') - MoreBy is the gap between two entities, not how far one entity moved
new_gaps: scalar endpoints have no head noun ('April's 6 percent', 'its highest'), so the mandatory witness typing must be improvised from outside the text
a superlative with an elided head noun ('its highest') supplies no comparison class, so the class slot has to be improvised as well
repair_summary: Replaced the ill-typed (Time sk_level_1 (Month april)) with the licensed genitive (Possession sk_level_1 april), renaming the proof name lvl1_time to lvl1_poss. Changed the superlative's class slot from unemployment_rate to level so it matches sk_level_2's own typing atom.
notes: The core clause (unemployment_rate witness with a noun-modifier genus, whole phrasal inch_up, Patient subject, Past) is right, as the reviewer says. Everything about the two endpoints is improvisation, but after these two fixes each emitted atom is true of the sentence and well-typed.
